# tools/ref9b/golden/llama_top_real.txt
# The seam capture of sim/tb_llama_top.vhd's REAL-PATH configuration,
# which is the generic set sim/tb_llama_top_real.vhd pins: real matvec_int4,
# real gdn_block, real attn_block, real rmsnorm_rs and the committed
# Qwen3.5-9B weight image sim/llama_top_w_b4_pool.hex -- plus SMP_EN, so it
# also carries the LOGITS seam and the argmax rtl/sampler_stream.vhd produced.
#
# HOW TO REPRODUCE IT, and there is no other recipe:
#   SMP=1 bash tools/ref9b/capture_llama_top.sh real
#
# HOW TO CHECK IT AGAINST THE MODELS, and the flags are NOT optional:
#   python3 tools/ref9b/bisect_scaled.py --blocks 4 --attn-int 4 --attn-hd 16 \
#       --norm real --w-image sim/llama_top_w_b4_pool.hex <capture>
#
# RUN IT WITH DEFAULTS AND IT REPORTS A DEFECT THAT IS NOT THERE.  MEASURED
# 2026-09-04: defaults gave "FIRST DIVERGENCE: R_XN-0 at element 0 -- expected
# -31488, captured -26133", seven more diverging seams, and two seams REFUSED.
# All of it was the wrong configuration.  bisect_scaled.py's own --help says
# so for one of the flags -- "the capture does NOT record this and guessing it
# wrong makes every norm seam diverge, which looks like a defect" -- and the
# same applies to --attn-hd and --w-image, which it does not warn about.
# This row pins ATTN_HD => 16, NORM_REAL => true and that weight image; with
# them passed, the divergence is gone AND the two refusals become checks,
# because the subsystem C oracle rejects HEAD_DIM=32 and accepts 16.
# 62 checked with a false alarm becomes 64 checked with none:
#
#   # 64 seams checked against a model, 0 NOT checked
#   EVERY MODELLED SEAM MATCHES ITS MODEL BIT FOR BIT, given the machine's
#   own inputs.
#
# THIS FILE IS NOT GATED, ON PURPOSE.  It is a CHARACTERISATION landmark:
# it says what the machine computed on this date, not that the numbers are
# right.  Gating on it would turn every legitimate numeric change by any
# track into a red gate row for a reason unrelated to that track.
# sim/mutate_llama_top_kv.sh's V rows generate their own clean baseline
# rather than reading this, for exactly that reason.
#
# THE CORRECTNESS CLAIM IS NOT IN THIS FILE.  It is in
# tools/ref9b/bisect_scaled.py, which compares 61 of these 65 records against
# independent models -- including LOGITS, against ref/matvec_int4.c in RAW
# out_mode, and TOKEN, against the argmax of the MODEL's logits.  The three it
# does NOT check are subsystem B's R_Y at each GDN block, which has no
# integration-level model, and the fourth record is R_X.embed, an input.
#
# WHY IT ROTS, AND HOW TO TELL.  This is a capture of the WORKING TREE at the
# moment it was taken, and any rtl/ commit on the real path moves it.  TRACK
# CAPTURE lost an hour on 2026-08-29 to exactly that ambiguity: a 670-line
# diff against this file read as staleness and was in fact a concurrent
# track's UNCOMMITTED edits, and the commit that looked guilty was innocent.
# So capture_llama_top.sh now stamps the revision AND the dirtiness of the
# tree it read, in the block immediately below.  Before concluding "stale",
# read that block, then `git archive <that rev> | tar -x` into scratch and
# re-capture there.
#
# The real fix is to generate this in the gate rather than commit it.  That
# needs a gate row and ~40 s of gate time, which is a decision for the
# dispatcher and not an edit; recorded in
# docs/debugging/2026-08-29_logits-seam-model.md section 8.
# captured by tools/ref9b/capture_llama_top.sh, configuration real
# HEAD ee2bd79  SMP=1
# tree clean under rtl/, sim/ and tools/: this IS a capture of that commit
# sim/tb_llama_top.vhd seam capture, run 0.  value = mant * 2^-exp.
# blocks=4 attn_interval=4 hidden=64 ffn=128  -- A SCALED SHAPE, not the 9B one.
